split_semantics: Legacy diagnostic labels, not partitions of the paper evaluation set or guarantees of held-out status.

split_rules.calibration: Legacy label retained for diagnostic filtering; included in the full-corpus paper evaluation.
split_rules.development: Legacy label retained for diagnostic filtering; included in the full-corpus paper evaluation.
split_rules.test: Legacy label retained for diagnostic filtering; included in the full-corpus paper evaluation, without establishing held-out status.

difficulty_rubric.formula: workstreams + milestones + dependency_edges + artifacts + 2*async_events + invalidated_artifact_refs + reopened_milestone_refs + ceil(instruction_chars/4000)

case_id_policy.near_duplicate_rule: Same source task set, event schedule, affected artifacts, and hidden-check semantics is one near-duplicate group.

split_freeze.evidence_status: The referenced assignment evidence is not included in the public release; the original exposure and held-out claims cannot be independently verified from this package.

superseded_split_rules.calibration: May be used for verifier and protocol calibration; never enters headline results.
superseded_split_rules.development: May be used while changing prompts, adapters, and implementation; never enters headline results.
superseded_split_rules.test: Held out from prompt, adapter, threshold, and verifier development; used for headline results only after the evaluation contract is frozen.

split_freeze.deduplication_rule: The duplicate secure-release instance tracebench-git-recovery-late-authority-001 was removed so every registered case family carries exactly one seed instance; the eight primary_event_theme lanes are 25 each.
split_freeze.rule: Registered cases with any recorded episode/pair evidence under artifacts/ are pinned to calibration and excluded from the held-out test split; 30 untouched cases are the deterministic (sha256-ranked) development buffer; remaining untouched cases form the held-out test split.
